# Contribution Table Examples

Use one of these formats in the final report. Replace names and update with the real work.

## Simple Version

| Member | Main Contribution | Files / Documents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Member A | Project integration, reservation workflow, approval workflow, run instructions | `App.java`, `LabWebServer.java`, `ReservationDao.java`, `ReservationService.java`, `app.js`, `README.md` |
| Member B | Database schema, ER model, seed data, database design documentation | `schema.sql`, `seed.sql`, `Database.java`, `03-uml-modeling.md`, `04-database-design.md` |
| Member C | Equipment catalogue and maintenance workflow | `EquipmentDao.java`, `MaintenanceDao.java`, `MaintenanceService.java`, `index.html`, `app.js` |
| Member D | Inventory workflow and reports | `InventoryDao.java`, `InventoryService.java`, `ReportDao.java`, `index.html`, `app.js` |
| Member E | Web front-end, model classes, testing, documentation, video script | `index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`, model classes, `SystemServiceTest.java`, `07-test-document.md`, `09-report-outline.md`, `10-video-script.md` |

## More Detailed Version

| Member | Design Work | Implementation Work | Testing / Documentation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Member A | Designed reservation use cases and approval flow | Implemented reservation service, DAO, and UI panel | Tested valid and conflicting reservation cases; wrote run instructions |
| Member B | Designed ER diagram and relational schema | Wrote SQL schema, constraints, views, indexes, and seed data | Wrote database design document and checked SQL consistency |
| Member C | Designed equipment status and maintenance status workflow | Implemented equipment search, ticket creation, ticket update, status synchronization | Tested maintenance reporting and resolution workflow |
| Member D | Designed stock management and report requirements | Implemented inventory service, stock transaction logic, report DAO, report UI | Tested stock update and negative stock prevention |
| Member E | Designed web UI layout and test plan | Implemented HTML/CSS/JavaScript front-end and login support | Wrote automated tests, manual test document, report outline, and video script |

## Short Paragraph Example

Our group divided the project by system module instead of assigning one person only to documentation. Member A focused on integration and reservation workflow, Member B focused on database design, Member C focused on equipment and maintenance, Member D focused on inventory and reports, and Member E focused on web front-end support, testing, and documentation. All members reviewed the ER diagram and practised explaining the main database transactions before the interview.
